display_long_description:
You wake up in a strange room with no idea how you got there.

Mannequins stand silently in the corners. Furniture is scattered around you. Endless buttons cover the walls.

No instructions. No clues. No obvious escape.

Just buttons.

Button Mystery: Horror Room Escape is a VR puzzle, adventure, and psychological horror experience where memory and observation matter.

What starts simple quickly becomes scary and thrilling. Solve puzzles, remember button locations, and uncover secrets hidden throughout the room. But things begin to change.

Strange random events appear. The atmosphere becomes more dark, chilling, and unsettling. Silent mannequins and unexpected moments create growing fear and dreadful suspense.

As you continue your adventure, you'll face mysterious events and wonder if something evil is hiding in the shadows.

Features

🧠 Remember & Survive – Track patterns, locations, and choices.

🔘 Unique Button Gameplay – A different kind of escape room puzzle challenge.

👁️ Uncover Secrets – Discover hidden clues and mysterious events.

😨 Psychological Horror – Scary moments, suspense, and growing fear.

🌑 Dark Atmosphere – Chilling surroundings with strange random events.

🔁 Replayable Experience – Different discoveries can change each run.

Can you escape, or will curiosity become your biggest mistake?
